entries.text: 1 PROVIDE GROUNDING IN ACCORDANCE WITH NEC ART.250. GROUNDING ELECTRODE / SYSTEM TO INCLUDE GROUND RODS, CONCRETE ENCASED ELECTRODE, STRUCTURAL / STEEL, METAL WATER PIPES AND OTHERS WHERE AVAILABLE.

2 CONDUIT ROUTING IS SCHEMATIC. COORINDATE STUBUP LOCATIONS WITH / EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER SO POWER AND CONTROL CONDUITS ENTER EQUIPMENT / ENCLOSURES AT DESIGNATED AREAS AND ROUTE TO APPROPRIATE MCC SECTION OR / CONTROL PANEL.
3 PROVIDE ALL CONNECTIONS TO BLOWERS AS REQUIRED BY MANUFACTURER. / INCLUDES MOTOR CONNECTIONS AND SENSORS. GROUND SKIDS PER NEC.
4 PROVIDE CEILING MOUNTED SMOKE/HEAT DETECTOR, COORDINATE FINAL LOCATION / WITH BUILDING CONSTRUCTION. SYSTEM SENSOR MODEL 4WTAR-B FORM C RELAY, / SOUNDER, 4-WIRE. WIRE TO PLC CONTROL PANEL.
5 PROVIDE DOOR SWITCH FOR INTRUSION MONITORING. MAGNETIC REED STYLE, SPDT, / INTERLOGIX SENTROL MODEL 2807T OR EQUAL. WIRE TO PLC CONTROL PANEL.
6 PROVIDE NEMA 4X STAINLESS STEEL LOCAL DISCONNECT.

7 ROUTE ALL FIELD CONDUITS FROM BLOWER BUILDING THROUGH HANDHOLES. / MAINTAIN SEPARATION OF POWER AND SIGNAL/CONTROL RACEWAYS. PROVIDE A / MINIMUM OF 2 SPARES FROM EACH POWER HANDHOLE TO MCC AND EACH CONTROL / HANDHOLE TO PLC PANEL. SEE PLANS AND SCHEDULES FOR DETAILS.

8 PROVIDE SEPARATE RACEWAY FROM PLC CONTROL PANEL TO MCC AS REQUIRED TO / MAINTAIN SEPARATION OF POWER, SIGNAL, AND DATA CABLING. COORDINATE STUB / UP LOCATIONS WITH EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS. WIRE SIZE AND QUANTITY PER / SCHEDULES AND AS REQUIRED FOR ALL CONNECTIONS BETWEEN MCC AND PLC / CONTROL PANEL.
